name: Ogata Toshiki
source:
The protagonist, in his 30s, 10 years older than Eri. 

For a long time, I couldn't connect with a woman because I only thought about work.
It was about the time when I wanted to get married, and I was introduced to her the president.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/073/index.html]official website[/url]]
